title: Threadify Growth Loop
summary: Review mature post evidence every six hours, promote repeatable hypotheses, prepare a four-proven/two-challenger daily queue, and save six drafts without scheduling them.
triggers: learn from mature posts and prepare tomorrow's drafts

inputs.name: verified account, mature post evidence, sources, templates, and private draft bodies

outputs.name: versioned private hypothesis ledger, six-card day, and body-free readbacks

free_capabilities: body-free run, hypothesis, pause, and save readbacks
paid_capability_stubs: connected analytics, source libraries, best-time evidence, offer reads, and draft saves depend on current Threadify scopes and plan entitlement
persistent execution depends on the selected agent host and an approved native or operating-system scheduler

must_show: six daily times and six-hour maturity interval
source rights and private state location
persistent runner route, device requirement, next run, and pause command
draft-only boundary with no automatic scheduling or publishing

instructions: Keep observations, hypotheses, exact draft bodies, and state in a private owner-controlled directory.
If connected evidence is unavailable, record it as unknown and do not invent a result or promotion.
Prepare the same six-card mix locally and hand drafts to the owner without claiming they were saved, scheduled, published, or commercially attributed.

must_prove: hypothesis threshold and commercial regression state
two-two-two sources, four-two roles, and two-two-two topics
draft-save intent and authoritative provider readback
persistent runner status, next run, and pause state
